title: DomainTrail configuration (domaintrail.jsonc / domaintrail.json)
description: Paths are relative to this file. CLI options (--out, --port, --host) take precedence.

sources.description: Globs of .dt and .dtes files, inside the directory of this file. Patterns starting with '!' exclude. node_modules, .git and .domaintrail are never scanned, nor (see respectGitignore) what .gitignore ignores.

respectGitignore.description: Skip the files and directories ignored by .gitignore when finding sources: the .gitignore files of this directory and its subdirectories, those above it up to the top of the git repository, and .git/info/exclude, with git's rules. Files named on the command line (dt fmt <files>) are never skipped.

lintHint.description: Let dt generate ts print a hint when no lint rule against casts to domain types (no-unsafe-type-assertion) is found in an oxlint or ESLint config from this directory up to the top of the git repository. See dt guide lint.

ts.description: TypeScript types and command contracts (dt generate ts).

out.description: Output directory of the contexts not listed in 'contexts', inside the directory of this file. Files previously generated by domaintrail are replaced; other files are never deleted or overwritten. --out replaces this value only.

policies.description: Whether the policies of a context must be implemented (ADR 0022): 'optional', a handler type per policy that nothing requires; 'required', also <Context>PolicyHandlers, which the contract tests of the context require. A context's own 'policies' (in 'contexts') overrides this.

contexts.description: Settings per context, keyed by context name (an unknown name is an error): a directory of its own instead of 'out' (which gets its own _runtime.ts and an index.ts of its contexts; imports between contexts use relative paths, or the context's 'module'), and how its policies are generated.

out.description: Output directory of this context, inside the directory of this file.

module.description: The module through which the package that 'out' is in exports this context's generated code (ADR 0028), e.g. '@acme/kernel'. Generated code in another output directory imports the context from it instead of by relative path, and its contract tests from '<module>/tests'; this context's contract tests are written into <out>/tests. Needs 'out'.

policies.description: Whether the policies of this context must be implemented; overrides generate.ts.policies.

tests.description: Contract tests generated from the model (ADR 0020), written only when this key is present: fast-check arbitraries of the types and a runner-agnostic suite per context. They import domaintrail/testing (a subpath of the domaintrail package); your project needs fast-check as a (dev) dependency.

out.description: Output directory of the test modules, inside the directory of this file. Default: 'tests' in the output directory ('out', or --out).

runner.description: Writes _register.ts, which registers a generated suite with this test runner.

maxRecursionDepth.description: How deep the drawn values of recursive types go: how many times a value nests through its cycle of types, counted where the cycle could end (a union's variant, an optional field, a list that may be empty). Values are biased towards shallow ones. A binary tree of depth 4 has at most 15 nodes.

types.description: Settings per type, by qualified name (Context.Type). Types on one cycle use the greatest maxRecursionDepth among them.

maxRecursionDepth.description: How deep the drawn values of this recursive type go; overrides maxRecursionDepth.

open.description: dt open: the Live View with the chat for one person (a non-loopback host serves the Live View read-only).

collab.description: Collaboration sessions (dt collab, dt collab link; ADR 0026, ADR 0030).

port.description: Port of the session's page and API.

host.description: Address to bind; the dev identity mode refuses anything but a loopback address.

identity.description: How participants prove who they are: dev (loopback only, a name picked on the first visit, a session cookie) or access (Cloudflare Access). Never inferred from headers.

publicUrl.description: The public URL of the session (the tunnel's, https). Not used to allow anything: dt collab refuses it unless its host is in allowedHosts and its origin in allowedOrigins.

allowedHosts.description: Host names the server answers to besides loopback (nothing external is allowed without them).

allowedOrigins.description: Origins (https://host[:port]) whose pages may call the server besides loopback.

acceptCookie.description: Accept the CF_Authorization cookie when the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header is absent (Cloudflare recommends the header).

avatarHosts.description: Hosts an avatar (the identity's https picture) may come from; without them the page shows initials.

quickReactions.description: The emoji the add-reaction popover of the chat offers first, in order: each exactly one emoji (one grapheme; ZWJ sequences, skin tones, flags and keycaps count as one), distinct. Any other emoji can still be typed there.

agent.description: The agent (dt agent, or in process with dt open and dt collab), in both modes: its API's port and its roles.

port.description: Port of the agent API, bound to 127.0.0.1 only; 0 picks a free port (written to .domaintrail/session/server.json; its credential is never written to disk).

run.description: The runner: the runs that edit the workspace, and how Claude Code carries them out.

allowedTools.description: The tools the agent may use, chosen by the facilitator, as Claude Code permission rules.

dt.description: The command the agent's dt runs (and the dt fmt / dt check after it), as an argument array, e.g. ["node", "../clone/dist/dt.js"]. An element with a path separator that is not absolute is relative to this file. Default: the running dt itself.

warm.description: Keep one Claude Code process across runs (each run one turn of its conversation; it is replaced now and then), or start one per run (false).

restartAfter.description: Runs of one warm Claude Code process before a fresh one replaces it.

idleTimeout.description: Minutes a warm Claude Code process may go without a run before it is ended to free its memory (the next run starts a fresh one); 0 = never.

model.description: The model Claude Code runs with (claude --model, e.g. "sonnet"). Default: the model of your Claude Code settings.

effort.description: The effort Claude Code runs with (claude --effort). Default: the effort of your Claude Code settings.

maxPreviousRunDiff.description: The most characters of unified diff the agent is given of the runs a run continues (the runs its messages reply to, the run it answers), all together; past it, only the files each changed.

answer.description: The answerer: read-only answers to the questions addressed to the AI (its tools, Read, Grep and Glob, are not configurable).

model.description: The model of the answers (claude --model). Default: the model of your Claude Code settings, never the runner's.

effort.description: The effort of the answers (claude --effort). Default: the effort of your Claude Code settings.

warm.description: Keep one Claude Code process across answers (each one turn of its conversation; it is replaced now and then), or start one per answer (false).

restartAfter.description: Answers of one warm Claude Code process before a fresh one replaces it.

idleTimeout.description: Minutes a warm Claude Code process may go without an answer before it is ended to free its memory; 0 = never.

timeout.description: The most seconds an answer may take.

triage.description: The light model that sorts the messages addressed to the AI (a question, a change request, or neither).

warm.description: Keep one Claude Code process for the triage (true), or start a fresh claude -p per message (false).

classifier.description: Classifying the messages addressed to the AI with Cloudflare Clef (opt-in), called by the server in both modes. When enabled, the text of each addressed message is sent to Cloudflare Workers AI.

enabled.description: Classify the chat's messages; otherwise every message can be applied.

model.description: The Clef model of Workers AI.

accountId.description: The Cloudflare account of Workers AI (required when enabled).

apiTokenEnv.description: The name of the environment variable holding the Workers AI API token (never the token itself).

threshold.description: The probability from which one of Clef's answers (a question, a change request, nothing to answer) decides the triage of a message addressed to the AI; below it, the light model decides.

templates.description: The team's message templates of the chat: typing / in the composer lists them after the built-in ones (and after the commands). Picking one only puts its text in the composer, to edit and send. Used by dt open and dt collab.

id.description: A stable ID, matched by what is typed after / (as is the name in the page's language).

name.description: The name the list shows: one for every language, or one per language.

text.description: The text put in the composer: one for every language, or one per language. {target} is where the selected element goes, as a # mention.

when.description: Where it is offered (any of them; absent: everywhere): a storming at Big Picture or Design Level (or any storming), a .dt view, anything selected, an aggregate, an event, a state selected, or nothing selected.
